in_sanskrit.name: Geetiya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Melody, Song
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Geetiya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Geetiya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'geeta', which means 'song' or 'melody'. In Hindu mythology, the Goddess Saraswati, who represents knowledge, music, and art, is often referred to as 'Geeta'. Thus, the name Geetiya symbolizes the divine gift of knowledge and creativity.
